claim_boundary: This is an experiment rejection record, not an end-to-end scan accuracy result.
reason: The larger-tail confirmation produced six false accepts, exposing unstable threshold-tail behaviour. The larger experiment was rejected instead of being used to claim that more synthetic data automatically improved production safety.
replacement: The deployed v2 guard uses the smaller grouped training protocol that passed threshold, frozen and independent confirmation with zero observed false accepts, plus an independent serial production-gate audit.
scope: Larger rendered training and confirmation trial for the dual-detector local pitch visual guard.
